os.path
— Common pathname manipulations
¶
Source code:
Lib/genericpath.py
,
Lib/posixpath.py
(for POSIX) and
Lib/ntpath.py
(for Windows).
This module implements some useful functions on pathnames. To read or write
files see
open()
, and for accessing the filesystem see the
os
module. The path parameters can be passed as strings, or bytes, or any object
implementing the
os.PathLike
protocol.
Unlike a Unix shell, Python does not do any
automatic
path expansions.
Functions such as
expanduser()
and
expandvars()
can be invoked
explicitly when an application desires shell-like path expansion.  (See also
the
glob
module.)
See also
The
pathlib
module offers high-level path objects.
Note
